summary.en: Moves like a chariot, captures by jumping one screen.
summary.zh: 走法像车，吃子要隔一个子（炮架）。

text.en: The cannon moves like a chariot. But to capture, it must jump over exactly one piece. From h2 it can take the horse on h9 by jumping the cannon on h7.
text.zh: 炮的走法和车一样，但吃子时必须隔一个子。h2的炮可以隔着h7的炮打掉h9的马。

text.en: Use your soldier as a screen and capture the chariot.
text.zh: 用你的兵当炮架，打掉黑车。

hint.en: Count the pieces between your cannon and the chariot.
hint.zh: 数一数炮和车之间有几个子。

success.en: Boom! The soldier was the screen (炮架).

text.en: Give check with your cannon. The black advisor can be your screen.
text.zh: 用炮将军，黑士可以当你的炮架。

hint.en: Line your cannon up with the black general.
hint.zh: 把炮移到黑将的那条纵线上。

success.en: Check! The advisor in front of the general became your screen.
success.zh: 将军！老将前面的士成了你的炮架。

text.en: How many pieces must be between a cannon and the piece it captures?
text.zh: 炮吃子时，中间要隔几个子？

explanation.en: Exactly one: that piece is called the screen (炮架).
explanation.zh: 正好一个，这个子叫“炮架”。
